pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Daddy-Long-Legs
work.note: Daddy-Long-Legs é um romance epistolar da americana Jean Webster, publicado em 1912. Uma jovem órfã, Judy, recebe de um benfeitor desconhecido a chance de estudar numa faculdade, com a condição de lhe escrever cartas mensais. Ela nunca vê o rosto dele, só uma sombra comprida, e por isso o chama de Daddy-Long-Legs. O elo com a língua fica claro na atividade “falar de cartas e e-mails com os verbos send, write e reply”

pages.title: From letters to texts · 1/3
paragraphs: Chloe lives in **Nashville**. Last night her friend Cole sent a text: “**Are you free tonight?**” She wrote back, “Yes! What’s up?” “Let’s get pizza at seven,” he said. “At Joe’s Pizza, near the park.”

Chloe smiled. Then she thought of a book she loves, “Daddy-Long-Legs.” An American writer, Jean Webster, wrote it in 1912. In the book, a girl named Judy writes a letter every month to a man she does not know. Each letter starts with **Dear…**. The man never writes back, but Judy tells him about her life.
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: From letters to texts · 2/3
paragraphs: Today we do not wait for the mail. We send a text, and our friend answers in seconds. But the old words still work. When Chloe writes a long note to her aunt, she ends it with **Write back soon**. When her aunt sends a gift, she says, “**It’s in the mail**!”
At seven Chloe walked to the park. Cole and Mia were at the pizza place. “**Can’t wait!**” Cole had said that afternoon, and now he was happy. They ate, laughed and took photos of the big pizza.

pages.title: From letters to texts · 3/3
paragraphs: Chloe writes a letter and a text. Both are good. A letter feels slow and special. A text is quick and fun. Which one do you like?
